title: Dennou Senki: Virtual On: Cyber Troopers for SegaNet
native_title: 電脳戦機バーチャロン フォー セガネット
overview:
Emergency!!

"Dennou Calendar": the face of a new era. "Virtuaroid": the overwhelming drive of ultra-high-speed mobile combat. "Full-polygon 3DCG": building an unknown world. "A new awakening": can you attain it?

- Change your machine's colors to create your own original VR
- Thrilling one-screen battles made possible by SegaNet-only online play

This edition of Virtual On is built for head-to-head play over SegaNet. Pick one of the giant combat robots called Virtuaroids and face another player in a one-on-one duel across a 3D arena, dashing to dodge fire while you strike back with each machine's three weapons - mostly ranged guns, plus some close-range attacks.

It cannot be played alone: a modem connection to an opponent on the network is required. Without one, only the options screen can be used.

- 2-player online battles over SegaNet (X-BAND)
- Requires the Sega Saturn Modem and Sega Saturn Media Card
- Twin Stick support
- Memory backup support

EMERGENCY!!

「電脳歴」新たなる時代の局面　「バーチャロイド」超高速起動戦闘の圧倒的ドライブ感　「フルポリゴン3DCG」未知の世界の構築　「新たなる覚醒」君は獲得できるのか

●マシンをカラー変更してオリジナルのVRを作成可能
●セガネット専用の通信プレイで実現した興奮の1画面対戦
